fields.Name: Credentialing Admin
fields.Description: Provisions accrediting organizations and their first staff members (Credentialing > Staff > Organizations). Works in programs only through a staff membership of an organization. Holds no UI role grant; its entity permissions are granted by the Credentialing app.

fields.Name: Credentialing Staff
fields.Description: Program staff of an accrediting organization: authors programs and runs the credentialing pipeline. Scope comes from Organization Membership rows; a staff member sees only the programs of organizations they are a member of.

fields.Name: Credentialing Committee
fields.Description: Member of a program's deciding committee: works the committee docket in the Review area. External role; every permission it holds is row-filtered.

fields.Name: Credentialing Reviewer
fields.Description: Peer reviewer assigned sections of applications in the Review area. External role; every permission it holds is row-filtered.

fields.Name: Credentialing Applicant
fields.Description: Contact of a credentialing subject who prepares and submits applications in the Applicant area. External role; every permission it holds is row-filtered.
